architecture_outline: Use Vue 3 Single-File Components with clear boundaries.
Separate UI, reusable reactive logic, API requests, and shared state when warranted.
Keep authoritative validation, prices, inventory, authentication, and payment verification on a backend.
reference_approach: For Full-Scale Commerce Platform, implement Responsive home page, catalog, and product details, Search, filters, sorting, and pagination, Cart and checkout form with server-confirmed totals, API service with loading/empty/error states, Router-based navigation and lazy-loaded views. Follow milestone order, keep state in one source of truth, and use the official documentation linked in the course.
review_checklist: Responsive home page, catalog, and product details
Cart and checkout form with server-confirmed totals
Pinia for appropriate shared UI state
Production build, deployment, configuration, and runbook
A normal and a failure/boundary case have repeatable evidence.
The build, runtime assumptions, and any untested paths are documented.
note: Protected architecture/reference outline only; no production credentials, secrets, or executable full solution is bundled.
